character: DJ Gifted Prophet — a young man with olive skin, Ray-Ban nerdy glasses, a goatee, wearing a black baseball cap with white letters 'LL' on the front. He is the DJ/performer.
concept: West Coast DJ-culture music video. DJ Gifted Prophet (the described young man) is the star — behind the turntables, crate-digging, dancing, commanding the blocks. Scenes themed by the lyrics: profit/blocks, cruise flow, laptop/scribe on the chain, Compton to Koreatown, basement crates + MPC, west side ride. A SMALL percentage of performance scenes get a slow-mo dance/DJ-cut pass synced to the beat for a real, cinematic feel. No on-screen text (lyrics carried by visuals).
